items.title: Joint Statement from OpenAI and Microsoft
items.summary: Microsoft and OpenAI continue to work closely across research, engineering, and product development, building on years of deep collaboration and shared success.
items.summaryZh: 微软与OpenAI发布联合声明，强调双方在研究、工程及产品开发层面的紧密协作。此次声明旨在巩固双方多年来的战略伙伴关系，并明确未来将继续在AI基础设施与模型研发领域保持深度绑定，对AI行业格局具有重要参考意义。

aiReview.reasonZh: 微软与OpenAI重申深度合作关系，对行业生态具有持续影响力。

items.title: Introducing the Stateful Runtime Environment for Agents in Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Stateful Runtime for Agents in Amazon Bedrock brings persistent orchestration, memory, and secure execution to multi-step AI workflows powered by OpenAI.
items.summaryZh: Amazon Bedrock推出状态化运行时环境（Stateful Runtime Environment），旨在为AI Agent提供持久化编排、记忆存储及安全执行能力。该功能支持多步骤AI工作流，能够有效提升基于OpenAI模型构建的智能体在复杂任务处理中的稳定性和上下文保持能力。

aiReview.reasonZh: Amazon Bedrock引入状态化运行时，显著提升了AI Agent在复杂工作流中的持久化与执行能力。

items.title: OpenAI and Amazon announce strategic partnership
items.summary: OpenAI and Amazon announce a strategic partnership bringing OpenAI’s Frontier platform to AWS, expanding AI infrastructure, custom models, and enterprise AI agents.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI与亚马逊宣布达成战略合作伙伴关系，将OpenAI的Frontier平台引入AWS云基础设施。此次合作旨在通过扩展AI基础设施、提供定制化模型服务，加速企业级AI Agent的开发与部署，进一步推动云端AI生态的深度融合。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与亚马逊达成战略合作，将前沿模型引入AWS，加速企业级AI Agent落地。

items.title: Scaling AI for everyone
items.summary: Today we’re announcing $110B in new investment at a $730B pre money valuation. This includes $30B from SoftBank, $30B from NVIDIA, and $50B from Amazon.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布获得大规模投资，涉及多家科技巨头。该消息主要关注资本运作，未涉及模型技术或应用层面的具体更新。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容主要涉及融资新闻，缺乏模型技术层面的实质性进展。

items.title: An update on our mental health-related work
items.summary: OpenAI shares updates on its mental health safety work, including parental controls, trusted contacts, improved distress detection, and recent litigation developments.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布关于心理健康安全工作的更新，包括家长控制和检测机制。此内容侧重于产品合规与社会责任，非技术性突破。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于公司合规与安全政策更新，与模型技术研发关联度较低。
